text:
lina: heads up — just got a customer report: node client throws JSON parse error on stream resume after an upstream connection drop. python client seems fine.

sam: do you have the raw SSE frames?

lina: yep. logged raw data from the client: first connection:
```
data: {"id":101,"chunk":"Start of message pa"}
```
then connection drops, reconnect yields:
```
data: {"id":102,"chunk":"rt 2 and end"}
```
When node concatenates these it becomes invalid because the split was mid-token.

rahul: this is classic: our Node streaming parser emits on stream end even if the last event doesn't end with a newline. Python's client waits for full event delimiters.

kate: two real-world triggers we've seen: token refresh aborts + upstream proxy idle timeouts. Token refresh cancels the request and opens a new one without attempting to sew the last partial event back.

lina: repro: I made a small server that sometimes does a FIN in the middle of data. Node fails ~10% with small messages.

sam: short term suggestions: server guarantees a trailing newline per event; include an event-id or resume-token in each event; clients should stash incomplete buffers keyed by resume-token/last-event-id and try to merge on reconnect.

rahul: agreed. For SDK parity, add an integration test that intentionally cuts streams mid-event and asserts both SDKs recover. Node change: don't try to parse buffer on 'end' if it's missing event delimiter; mark as incomplete and retain until reconnect.

kate: also audit auth refresh flow: can we delay refresh until a safe boundary or make refresh piggyback so we can resume? Either way, we need an RFC.

lina: proposed action items:
- flaky CI test (sse-midframe-reconnect) covering abrupt close + auth-refresh combos (node + python)
- Node SDK: stash incomplete last-event, attempt merge on reconnect by resume token
- Docs: streaming semantics page update (server newline requirement + client reassembly guidance)
- Short-term: advise enabling 10-15s heartbeats in client to avoid proxy idle kills

sam: I'll add the CI harness and test script. @rahul can you take the Node parser patch and tests? @kate pls open the RFC and an issue for token refresh behavior.

rahul: will open PRs this week. quick patch: treat trailing partial as 'pending' and attach to session store keyed by last-event-id. on reconnect, try to merge and only emit when JSON parse succeeds.

reconnect-bot: New job queued: nightly/sse-midframe-reconnect-test.

kate: created issue #5230: "streaming: recover from mid-event connection close and auth refresh" with logs and repro link.

lina: thanks team. adding a note to devex guide and informing the customer about heartbeat workaround. will follow up after CI results. :thumbsup:
